'''Corps Command''' was a command unit in the [[Ralltiir Corps]], a military unit in service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. [[Graayson's Company]]&mdash;another unit in the [[Corps/Legends|corps]]&mdash;reported directly to Corps Command as part of the arrangement under which it had entered Republic service despite being smaller than other, [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]]-sized units in the corps.<ref name="KOTOR guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corps Command first introduced in ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2008]] supplement to [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. Its mention within "Chapter XI: The Republic"<ref name="KOTOR guide" /> was written by [[John Jackson Miller]].<ref name="Miller Campaign">{{Faraway|url=games/swkotorguide.html|text=Star Wars Roleplaying Game: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide}}</ref>
